purpose: Pilot-scoped, NON-OPERATIONAL claim records for Pilot 02 (OCP Group x sulfur x Morocco industrial context x FY2024). Kept OUT of the canonical claim registries. Claims A and B are SUPPORTED from the ORIGINAL OCP consolidated financial statements; Claim C is now SUPPORTED from a direct page-excerpt (original report page 20) of the OCP Sustainability Integrated Report 2024. Supporting evidence IDs are mandatory for a supported claim; organization identity / source existence do NOT count as evidence. Claim approval does not authorize publication.
relationship_state: evidence_collecting (issuer-specific, FY2024-bounded; not upgraded — same-issuer reports are not independent corroboration)

claims.statement: OCP Group's FY2024 consolidated financial statements (Note 4.2.2, 'Purchases consumed', 'In millions of dirhams', page 21) report 'Sulfur' under raw-material purchases with a source-presented amount of (8,344) million dirhams for FY2024 (FY2023: (8,088)).
claims.scope_guard: OCP's OWN accounting line only. NOT sulfur import value, NOT physical consumption tonnage, NOT Morocco/national sulfur demand, NOT sulfur market size. 'Sulfuric acid' (2,364) is a distinct line and is not merged in.

claims.statement: OCP reports that its sulfur consumption volumes increased in correlation with the rise in sulfuric-acid production during FY2024 (issuer-reported, MD&A narrative, page 21).
claims.scope_guard: Issuer-reported, OCP-own-operations, FY2024-scoped increase-in-correlation observation ONLY. No absolute tonnage, no percentage, no causal elasticity, no national consumption. Not to be conflated with the (quarantined) price statement.

claims.statement: Per OCP's Sustainability Integrated Report 2024 (original report page 20), OCP's phosphate processing takes place at two platforms located in Jorf Lasfar and Safi, where phosphate rock is combined with sulphuric acid to create phosphoric acid; these sites are equipped with sulphuric-acid and phosphoric-acid production lines.
claims.scope_guard: Issuer-primary, organization-scoped, site-scoped (Jorf Lasfar, Safi) process CONTEXT only. Does NOT by itself prove sulfur feedstock quantities or national sulfur demand. 'sulphuric acid'/'phosphoric acid' kept as qualitative text; no 'sulfuric_acid' ontology concept fabricated. The page-305/306 third-party assurance (GHG/clean-electricity/waste/water metrics) does NOT assure this process statement.
